claims.statement: Tom Allen and John Mace signed articles at the Clipper office in New York for a prize fight for $2,500 and the championship, to be fought on 10 May 1870 within fifty miles of New Orleans.
claims.excerpt: by John Mace in person and by Frank Burns on behalf of Tom Allen

fights.place: within fifty miles of New Orleans
fights.excerpt: The fight has been fixed to come off on the 10th of May.
fights.notes: Planned bout; not yet fought in this article. The paper gives 'John Mace'; other articles say 'Jem Mace'.

notes: Only the signed match is reported; the baseball item is not about Allen.
